## Key configuration

name: cdn-explorer
requires-python: >=3.14
version: 0.1.0

## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
api/__init__.py
api/config.py — Application configuration via environment variables.
api/constants.py — Application-wide constants.
api/crawler.py — CDN crawler — parses directory listings and extracts asset links.
api/fixtures.py — Demo-mode fixtures — realistic crawl results served without network access.
api/main.py — FastAPI application entry point.
api/observability/__init__.py — Observability — Sentry error tracking for cdn-explorer API.
api/routers/__init__.py
api/routers/explore.py — Explore router — CDN crawling and file download proxy.
api/schemas.py — Pydantic schemas for the CDN explorer API.
api/ssrf.py — SSRF guard — reject URLs that resolve to non-public IP ranges.
scripts/gen_context_files.py — Generate the standardised per-repo context files from the repo's own content.
scripts/quality_gate.py
tests/__init__.py
tests/conftest.py — Pytest configuration and shared fixtures.
tests/test_crawler.py — Unit tests for the crawler module.
tests/test_demo_mode.py — Demo mode — the crawler serves fixtures and contacts no real CDN.
tests/test_explore.py — Tests for the /api/explore and /api/download endpoints.
tests/test_ssrf.py — Unit tests for the SSRF guard.
